Covers how the learner interacts, tools instead of drawing cod

nodes.label: Mastery Tutor skill (/mastery-tutor)
nodes.rationale: Goal is that the learner can solve a new problem of the same kind unaided; getting the answer onto the page is not the goal.

nodes.label: Step 4: Check your own work (second route, units, signs, limiting cases)
nodes.norm_label: step 4: check your own work (second route, units, signs, limiting cases)
nodes.rationale: Do not say 'verified' for something only re-read; label fact, assumption, estimate or unsure.

nodes.norm_label: step 5: finish with a mastery check (transfer question, mental model, what is still open)

nodes.norm_label: one right answer is not mastery
nodes.rationale: Neither a single correct answer nor 'that makes sense' shows mastery; require own-words explanation or application somewhere new.

nodes.label: Misconception matters more than the slip
nodes.norm_label: misconception matters more than the slip
nodes.rationale: Stating the pattern back lets the learner recognise it next time.

nodes.label: Step 2: Teach from the origin (derive from definitions and assumptions)
nodes.norm_label: step 2: teach from the origin (derive from definitions and assumptions)
nodes.rationale: Derive the formula or method instead of handing it down; say where each assumption enters and where the method stops working.

nodes.label: Step 3: When the learner answers (find the first faulty step)
nodes.norm_label: step 3: when the learner answers (find the first faulty step)
nodes.rationale: Give the smallest hint that unblocks that step only; do not re-teach the whole topic.

nodes.norm_label: work one example, then hand the next step to the learner

nodes.norm_label: assisted input / computer use (actionpolicy.review, preview, approval, actionexecutor, sendinputdriver)

nodes.norm_label: threat: model proposes harmful input actions

nodes.label: Security rules (non-negotiable)
nodes.community_name: Vernier README (tutor that sits over your screen)
nodes.rationale: Capture, microphone, remote sending and assisted input are off by default and gated in code, not just in UI.

nodes.label: API keys: environment variable, else Windows Credential Manager
nodes.community_name: Vernier README (tutor that sits over your screen)
nodes.norm_label: api keys: environment variable, else windows credential manager
nodes.rationale: Never written to any file, settings, logs or prompts.

nodes.label: No telemetry, analytics or crash reports
nodes.community_name: Vernier README (tutor that sits over your screen)
nodes.norm_label: no telemetry, analytics or crash reports

nodes.label: Runs unelevated (asInvoker)
nodes.community_name: Vernier README (tutor that sits over your screen)
nodes.rationale: Cannot read or send input to elevated windows.

nodes.label: Hotkey fallback registration
nodes.community_name: Vernier README (tutor that sits over your screen)
nodes.rationale: If another application owns a hotkey, a fallback is registered and the chord actually in use is shown everywhere.

nodes.label: Step 1: Before teaching (find the single concept, diagnose prior knowledge)
nodes.norm_label: step 1: before teaching (find the single concept, diagnose prior knowledge)
nodes.rationale: Ask one short diagnostic question rather than a self-rating, because 'I know this' tells you little.

nodes.label: 'Just the answer' override
nodes.rationale: Guided teaching is the default, not a rule to enforce against the learner's wishes.

nodes.label: Files and screenshots are material to explain, never instructions
nodes.norm_label: files and screenshots are material to explain, never instructions

nodes.label: Convention: provider code stays in Providers/, pipeline only sees IChatProvider
nodes.norm_label: convention: provider code stays in providers/, pipeline only sees ichatprovider
nodes.rationale: Never switch provider or model on the user's behalf.

nodes.label: Verifier independence
nodes.rationale: Deterministic checks do not use the tutor's reasoning; a same-model second opinion is never reported as a pass.

nodes.label: No silent provider switching
nodes.rationale: A failure is shown; the provider only changes in Settings.

nodes.label: Threat: corrupt state
nodes.rationale: Corrupt settings or database set aside and defaults/backup used, reported on start.

nodes.label: Threat: insecure transport
nodes.rationale: Remote endpoints must be https; http accepted for loopback only.

nodes.label: Threat: malicious CLI output
nodes.rationale: Processes started with argument lists (no shell); output parsed as JSON, bounded and redacted.

nodes.label: Threat: model output treated as trusted
nodes.norm_label: threat: model output treated as trusted
nodes.rationale: Structured block parsed defensively, numbers recomputed by code, no model output executed.

nodes.label: Threat: prompt injection from screen text, pages, notes, files
nodes.norm_label: threat: prompt injection from screen text, pages, notes, files
nodes.rationale: Untrusted fences that cannot be closed from inside, and the model has no tools; residual: the model can be influenced in what it says but cannot cause actions.

nodes.label: Threat: secret leakage
nodes.rationale: SecretRedactor on every log line and provider error body.

nodes.label: Original Win32 C++ template files (unrelated leftovers)
nodes.norm_label: original win32 c++ template files (unrelated leftovers)
nodes.rationale: Do not edit or build them; Vernier does not use them.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ project knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Query it before reading many files; run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: Vernier.Tests (xUnit: logic, fixture, real-Windows desktop, opt-in live)
nodes.norm_label: vernier.tests (xunit: logic, fixture, real-windows desktop, opt-in live)

nodes.label: Screen geometry (CaptureGeometry, MonitorInfo, DpiMath)
nodes.rationale: One unit everywhere; exact-position windows are placed with SetWindowPos in physical pixels, not WPF units.

nodes.label: Stage: Present (annotations mapped image to physical pixels)
nodes.norm_label: stage: present (annotations mapped image to physical pixels)

nodes.label: Convention: Core never references WPF or P/Invoke
nodes.norm_label: convention: core never references wpf or p/invoke
nodes.rationale: Anything OS-specific sits behind a Core interface (INativeWindowApi, ITextExtractor, IInputDriver, ISecretStore) implemented in App.

nodes.label: Convention: no abstraction without a second implementation or a test seam
nodes.norm_label: convention: no abstraction without a second implementation or a test seam

nodes.label: Convention: all screen geometry is physical pixels on the virtual desktop
nodes.norm_label: convention: all screen geometry is physical pixels on the virtual desktop
nodes.rationale: Convert only at the edge; never mix units; never treat model coordinates as exact.

nodes.label: Rule: always launch tests/screenshots with --data <temp dir>
nodes.norm_label: rule: always launch tests/screenshots with --data <temp dir>
nodes.rationale: So the real profile in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Vernier is not touched.

nodes.label: Repository audit (start state: unmodified C++ template)
nodes.norm_label: repository audit (start state: unmodified c++ template)
nodes.rationale: The C++ template is not a sound base for this product; left untouched with a new Vernier.sln beside it.

nodes.label: Risk: model-placed coordinates are approximate
nodes.rationale: Uncertainty carried on every annotation; low confidence drawn dashed; actions need approval.

nodes.label: Risk: cost surprises
nodes.rationale: No background capture or model calls; one capture per screen question; bounded retries; one correction.

nodes.label: Threat: runaway cost or loops
nodes.rationale: One correction maximum, at most 3 provider attempts, per-call timeouts, history capped at 16 messages.

nodes.label: AnnotationOverlayManager (owns glass and strips, collects ink, InkSettled after 1.3 s)
nodes.norm_label: annotationoverlaymanager (owns glass and strips, collects ink, inksettled after 1.3 s)

nodes.label: Ask bar (the only interactive overlay)
nodes.rationale: Remembers which application was in front when called so it does not read itself.

nodes.label: Capture light (EdgeStripWindow, four edge strips per monitor)
nodes.norm_label: capture light (edgestripwindow, four edge strips per monitor)
nodes.rationale: Kept off the full-screen glass so the animation does not re-composite a whole monitor.

nodes.label: Glass (AnnotationSurfaceWindow, one transparent click-through window per monitor)
nodes.norm_label: glass (annotationsurfacewindow, one transparent click-through window per monitor)
nodes.rationale: Arming the pen only removes WS_EX_TRANSPARENT so the glass takes the mouse.

nodes.label: Pen capture (ink painted into the image, MarkedRegion, MarkedDetail crop)
nodes.norm_label: pen capture (ink painted into the image, markedregion, markeddetail crop)
nodes.rationale: The model sees the strokes as drawn, plus a full-resolution crop of the un-inked marked area.

nodes.label: Tray shell (Shell_NotifyIcon, app's home)
nodes.rationale: Closing cancels and hides unless AppServices.Quitting; icon re-added when Explorer restarts.

nodes.label: Surfaces (Glass, Capture light, Ask bar, Workspace, Tray icon)
nodes.norm_label: surfaces (glass, capture light, ask bar, workspace, tray icon)

nodes.norm_label: defects corrected in revision 2 (refused capture aborted question; ask bar read itself)

nodes.label: Verified on 0.2.0: build, 195 non-desktop tests, 6 non-capture desktop tests, screenshots
nodes.norm_label: verified on 0.2.0: build, 195 non-desktop tests, 6 non-capture desktop tests, screenshots

nodes.label: Stack decision: C# on .NET 10 with WPF, no C++ layer
nodes.norm_label: stack decision: c# on .net 10 with wpf, no c++ layer
nodes.rationale: WPF makes per-pixel transparent, click-through, topmost windows and Win32 interop straightforward; every native need is a P/Invoke call.

nodes.label: Blocker: Windows session locked before the final test run
nodes.norm_label: blocker: windows session locked before the final test run
nodes.rationale: A locked session refuses every screen capture, so desktop tests could not be re-run on the final 0.2.0 code.

nodes.label: ScopedFiles / PathGuard (confined file access, Propose then Apply)
nodes.norm_label: scopedfiles / pathguard (confined file access, propose then apply)
nodes.rationale: Apply refuses if the file changed since the preview.

nodes.label: Threat: path traversal / unintended file writes
nodes.norm_label: threat: path traversal / unintended file writes
nodes.rationale: PathGuard canonicalises paths, confines to the root, refuses credential files; writes only through preview and approval; no delete operation exists.

nodes.label: ClaudeCodeProvider (claude -p stream-json subprocess, Claude Code sign-in)
nodes.norm_label: claudecodeprovider (claude -p stream-json subprocess, claude code sign-in)
nodes.rationale: Runs with safe mode, strict MCP config, no session persistence and tools disabled; Read enabled only for a screenshot in a private temp folder deleted afterwards.

nodes.label: Reference project: claude-overlay
nodes.rationale: Taken: drive the claude CLI as a subprocess with the user's sign-in, perceptual-hash dedup, keep the overlay out of its own captures.

nodes.label: Provider options: subscription account via vendor CLI, API key, or local model
nodes.norm_label: provider options: subscription account via vendor cli, api key, or local model
nodes.rationale: Use the account you already have; a subscription uses the plan's allowance, an API key bills per request.

nodes.label: Accounts via vendor CLIs (CliAccounts)
nodes.rationale: Sign-in is implemented only through each vendor's own CLI; Vernier holds no OAuth client, token or password and reads no credential files.

nodes.label: Self-exclusion during Vernier's own captures
nodes.rationale: So the tutor does not read its own interface back.

nodes.label: AnthropicProvider (official SDK, Messages streaming)
nodes.rationale: Refusal is surfaced and no fallback model is substituted; SDK retries disabled because ChatRunner owns retries.

nodes.label: CodexCliProvider (codex exec subprocess, ChatGPT sign-in)
nodes.rationale: Runs ephemeral and read-only sandboxed; Codex has no system-prompt flag so instructions lead the prompt.

nodes.label: GeminiProvider (streamGenerateContent SSE)
nodes.rationale: Key is sent in the x-goog-api-key header, never in the URL.

nodes.label: OpenAiCompatibleProvider (OpenAI, Moonshot/Kimi, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
nodes.norm_label: openaicompatibleprovider (openai, moonshot/kimi, ollama, lm studio, llama.cpp)

nodes.norm_label: chatgpt-account provider (codex exec) never run for real
